findings.highlight: “Three[line4]what’s your reply, Emiya-kun?”
findings.evidenceJa: 「三秒[line4]衛宮くん、返事は」
findings.governingReading: Rin’s three-second countdown is interrupted as she asks Emiya-kun for his answer.
findings.explanation: The English runs “Three” directly into the question and reverses the address position, leaving a visibly malformed transition.

findings.highlight: It’s dangerous to go by yourself!
findings.evidenceJa: 一人で先走ったら危ないわよ！
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that it is dangerous for Shirou to rush ahead impulsively on his own.
findings.explanation: The English keeps solitude and danger but removes 先走る, her criticism of his rash anticipatory action.

findings.highlight: She must be in the first year.
findings.evidenceJa: 一年生だろうか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether the collapsed girl is a first-year student.
findings.explanation: “Must be” promotes an open visual estimate into strong certainty.

findings.highlight: I don’t see any wounds, so she should be all right.
findings.evidenceJa: 出血も外傷もなく、とりわけ大事という訳ではなさそうだ。
findings.governingReading: She appears neither to be bleeding nor to have external injuries, and therefore does not seem in especially grave condition.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two distinct checks into generic wounds and strengthens the limited visual assessment into being all right.

findings.highlight: It’s only natural for someone to die if they’re empty inside even if they don’t have any external wounds.
findings.evidenceJa: 外が無事でも中が空っぽなら動かなくなるのは当たり前でしょ。
findings.governingReading: Even with an unharmed exterior, a body emptied within will naturally cease to function or move.
findings.explanation: The English changes bodily shutdown into death, overstating Rin’s immediate physiological explanation before her separate warning that the girl will die if untreated.

findings.highlight: external wounds. …Hold on
findings.evidenceJa: 血がぜんっぜん足りないのよ。
findings.governingReading: Rin emphasizes that the girl has nowhere near enough blood or vital supply.
findings.explanation: The English omits the sentence completely, deleting the concrete metaphor by which Rin explains the drained life force.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka seems to know how to cure her.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は治療法を知っているようだ。
findings.governingReading: Rin appears to know a method of treatment.
findings.explanation: “Cure” promises complete restoration where 治療法 states only a way to treat the condition.

findings.highlight: That serious face of hers… I think I saw it recently
findings.evidenceJa: 見ている方が痛みを覚えるほどの真剣な顔を、俺は。つい最近、すごく間近で見た覚えが
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers seeing that painfully earnest expression extremely close by only very recently.
findings.explanation: The English retains a recent memory but omits the face’s painful intensity and extreme proximity, weakening the clue linking Rin’s present care to her treatment of Shirou.

findings.highlight: I sense “something” black being shot
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い“何か”が飛んでくるような気がして
findings.governingReading: Shirou has the feeling that a black “something” is flying toward them.
findings.explanation: “Being shot” supplies a definite launch mechanism and agentive attack where the source preserves only a reflexive impression of motion.

findings.highlight: I protect Tohsaka with my right arm.
findings.evidenceJa: 右手で、遠坂の顔を[ruby text=かば]庇った。
findings.governingReading: Shirou shields Rin’s face with his right hand.
findings.explanation: The English changes hand to arm and omits that he specifically interposes it before Rin’s face, weakening the exact sacrificial action.

findings.highlight: The thing lodged in between my wrist and my arm looks like a nail.
findings.evidenceJa: 肘と手の中間に刺さったそれは、釘に似ている。
findings.governingReading: The object is lodged midway between Shirou’s elbow and hand and resembles a nail.
findings.explanation: “Between my wrist and my arm” is anatomically incoherent and moves the stated wound location.

findings.highlight: it’s too big to call it a nail.
findings.evidenceJa: 釘というには鉄塊すぎる。
findings.governingReading: It is too much a solid mass of iron to be called a nail.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only size and omits the dense iron mass that motivates reclassification as a dagger.

findings.highlight: it hurts so much that I can’t panic.
findings.evidenceJa: あんまりにも痛すぎて、冷静にパニックできない。
findings.governingReading: The pain is so extreme that Shirou cannot even panic in an orderly or lucid way.
findings.explanation: The English drops 冷静に and with it Shirou’s paradoxical self-observation about being unable to panic calmly.

findings.highlight: I start running.
findings.evidenceJa: 床を蹴る。
findings.governingReading: Shirou kicks off hard against the floor.
findings.explanation: The English states the resulting run but removes the explosive physical action that launches his pursuit.

findings.highlight: now this one almost got ripped off.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はこうして、引きちぎれそうな腕を抱えている。
findings.governingReading: Now Shirou is carrying an arm that feels on the verge of being torn away.
findings.explanation: The English changes an ongoing bodily condition into a past near-event and omits his burdened handling of the injured arm.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what I’m feeling, but I certainly feel it.
findings.evidenceJa: 何に引っ張られているかは判らないが、確かに感じる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot identify what is pulling or drawing him, but he can certainly sense it.
findings.explanation: The English removes the directional pull guiding him toward the attacker and replaces it with an unspecified feeling.

findings.highlight: the “person” that attacked Tohsaka with that dagger is nearby.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に短剣を放った“何か”は、すぐ近くにいる。
findings.governingReading: The “something” that launched the dagger at Rin is very close; its personhood remains unestablished.
findings.explanation: The English calls it a person and generalizes the launched dagger into an attack, prematurely resolving the entity’s nature.

findings.highlight: The person is still around.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ見失っていない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou has not yet lost track of the moving presence.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his active tracking relation with a static claim that the already misidentified person remains nearby.

findings.highlight: run across the moldy land.
findings.evidenceJa: 腐葉土の地面を走る。
findings.governingReading: Shirou runs across ground layered with leaf mold or decaying forest litter.
findings.explanation: “Moldy land” mistakes 腐葉土’s ordinary woodland soil for terrain covered in mold and produces unnatural English.

findings.highlight: Someone I recognize is standing there, smiling.
findings.evidenceJa: 木々に隠れるように、見知った顔が、俺を見て笑っていた。
findings.governingReading: A familiar face, half-hidden among the trees, looks directly at Shirou and smiles.
findings.explanation: The English omits concealment and that the recognized person is watching Shirou, weakening the staged revelation.

findings.highlight: The instant I fall to the ground…
findings.evidenceJa: クン、と体が前のめりに倒れそうになった瞬間
findings.governingReading: At a sharp tug, Shirou’s body is just about to pitch forward.
findings.explanation: The English omits the tug and converts a near-fall into an actual fall to the ground, changing his position at the ambush.

findings.highlight: I just keep falling and keep rolling forward to avoid it.
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろでも横でもなく、つんのめる体に逆らわず、思いっきり地面に前転してやりすごした。
findings.governingReading: Rather than moving back or sideways, Shirou deliberately follows his pitching momentum into a full-force forward roll along the ground.
findings.explanation: The English omits the rejected escape vectors and turns the calculated use of his fall into passively continuing to fall.

findings.highlight: If I had been a second too late, it would’ve been my throat that got cut.
findings.evidenceJa: 一歩遅ければ、皮膚ではなく骨を串刺しにされていたのだから。
findings.governingReading: Had Shirou been one step slower, the weapon would have skewered bone rather than merely tearing skin.
findings.explanation: The English changes a spatial step into a second, bone into throat, and skewering into cutting.

findings.highlight: …Stands a smiling woman in black. woman in black with an irritating smile.
findings.evidenceJa: 笑みをうかべた、黒一色の女がいた。
findings.governingReading: Before Shirou stands a woman entirely in black, wearing a smile.
findings.explanation: The English exposes two competing description fragments and adds that the smile is irritating, producing both revision debris and unsupported characterization.

findings.highlight: A concentration of magical energy even Tohsaka cannot stand up to.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂でさえ霞むほどの、人間離れした魔力の塊。
findings.governingReading: The inhuman concentration of magical energy makes even Rin’s presence pale by comparison.
findings.explanation: “Cannot stand up to” converts a comparison of overwhelming magical presence into a claim that Rin could not oppose the Servant in combat.

findings.highlight: An ethereal beauty and a thick smell of blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 夢か幻と見紛うほどの美しさと、濃密なまでに血に濡れたその姿。[lr]
findings.governingReading: This semicolon-commented inactive line describes dreamlike beauty and a figure so thoroughly drenched in blood as to seem dense with it.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally activates prose absent from the running Japanese and then changes the blood-drenched figure into “a thick smell of blood.”

findings.highlight: It should be able to block any attacks from behind me now.
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず背後からの奇襲はこれで防げる。
findings.governingReading: With his back against the tree, Shirou can for the moment prevent a surprise attack from behind.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the blocking to the tree and broadens one rear ambush vector into any attack from behind.

findings.highlight: I don’t see her coming down.
findings.evidenceJa: 女は一度たりとも地上に降りては来ない。
findings.governingReading: The woman does not come down to the ground even once.
findings.explanation: The English changes an observed movement pattern into Shirou’s limited failure to see her descend.

findings.highlight: The sound of chains is like that of a snake aiming for its prey.
findings.evidenceJa: ジャラジャラという音は、獲物を狙う蛇そのものだ。
findings.governingReading: The jangling sound is itself a snake stalking its prey.
findings.explanation: The English turns an identity metaphor into a comparison with the sound a snake makes, an image the source does not use.

findings.highlight: I might be killed in the next moment
findings.evidenceJa: 次に襲われたら間違いなく殺される
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows without doubt that the next attack will kill him.
findings.explanation: “Might” removes the source’s explicit certainty and changes “when next attacked” into a general next moment.

findings.highlight: the guillotine isn’t coming down.
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ギロチン char=3]断頭台の紐は解かれたまま、いつまでたっても落ちてこない。
findings.governingReading: The guillotine cord has already been released, yet the blade refuses to fall no matter how long he waits.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the suspended guillotine but omits the released cord and interminable delay that create the torture of waiting.

findings.highlight: I think I might have been killed by that previous surprise attack and might be merely dreaming now.
findings.evidenceJa: 死後の夢なのではないかと思いこみたくなるぐらい、真っ白だった。
findings.governingReading: His mind is so utterly white that he almost wants to convince himself this terror is a post-death dream.
findings.explanation: The English presents the possibility as a thought and omits both his desire to believe it and the blankness producing that wish.

findings.highlight: I placed myself in this dangerous situation. Then, I should hold responsibility for that
findings.evidenceJa: この死地には自分から飛び込んだのだ。なら、その責任はこの手で果たすべきだし
findings.governingReading: Shirou threw himself voluntarily into this place of death and believes he must discharge that responsibility with his own hand.
findings.explanation: “Dangerous situation” weakens 死地, while “hold responsibility” obscures his insistence on personally acting to fulfill it before calling Saber.

findings.highlight: You’re not using your Command Spell?
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を使わないのですね、貴方は
findings.governingReading: Rider observes with surprise that Shirou is choosing not to use a Command Spell.
findings.explanation: The English question mark turns her cool recognition of his choice into a request for confirmation.

findings.highlight: You must be brave unlike my Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 私のマスターと違って勇敢なのですね、貴方は
findings.governingReading: Rider judges Shirou brave, unlike her own Master.
findings.explanation: “Must be” distances her direct evaluation into an inference and weakens the pointed comparison with Shinji.

findings.highlight: I cannot go all out against a Master without his Servant[line4]I shall kindly kill you.
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントのいないマスターに本気は出せませんから[line4]貴方は、優しく殺してあげます
findings.governingReading: Because Rider cannot fight seriously against a Master without his Servant, she promises to kill Shirou gently.
findings.explanation: The English loses the clause boundary and runs “Servant” into “I,” visibly damaging Rider’s controlled, ceremonious threat.

findings.highlight: She’s coming.
findings.evidenceJa: ……来るか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou tensely wonders whether or when the next attack will come.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his watchful question into certain declaration.

findings.highlight: defend myself using a chair leg
findings.evidenceJa: 椅子の脚を“強化”しただけの物
findings.governingReading: The pathetic tool is specifically nothing more than a Strengthened chair leg.
findings.explanation: The English omits Strengthening from the description, breaking the contrast between Shirou’s crude magecraft and Rider’s splendid weapon.

findings.highlight: If this stick was as splendid as the weapons he had
findings.evidenceJa: この棒が、あいつの武器ぐらい立派だったら
findings.governingReading: Shirou wishes this rod were as splendid as that woman Rider’s weapon.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the weapon and assigns it to a male “he,” losing the immediate comparison with Rider’s chain weapon.

findings.highlight: If I at least had[line4][lr] If this stick was
findings.evidenceJa: せめて、そう[line4]この棒が
findings.governingReading: Shirou corrects and completes his hypothetical thought: if only this rod were as splendid as Rider’s weapon.
findings.explanation: The English exposes two competing conditional openings instead of presenting the self-corrected sentence.

findings.highlight: using the weapon, I block the roundhouse kick executed by the Servant.
findings.evidenceJa: ついで左、地面すれすれに着地したサーヴァントが放った回し蹴りを“武器”で受ける。
findings.governingReading: Next from the left, Rider lands skimming the ground and launches a roundhouse kick that Shirou catches on his weapon.
findings.explanation: The English retains the kick and block but omits its leftward origin and Rider’s ground-skimming landing.

findings.highlight: She’s in front of me now. I repel her attacks!
findings.evidenceJa: 次に正面。二度の襲撃を防がれた苛立ちか、立て続けに放たれた剣戟をことごとく弾き返す！
findings.governingReading: Rider moves to the front and, perhaps irritated that two assaults failed, unleashes consecutive blade strikes which Shirou repels one after another.
findings.explanation: The English deletes Rider’s inferred irritation, the blade-strike category, and the successive all-repelled structure.

findings.highlight: I can’t even see her movements.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺には敵の姿さえ見えていない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot even see the enemy’s figure at all.
findings.explanation: The English changes total visual absence of Rider herself into difficulty seeing her movements.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou could not block such attacks.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎では躱す事など不可能な一撃は
findings.governingReading: The opening overhead blow was a single attack impossible for Emiya Shirou to evade.
findings.explanation: The English changes evasion to blocking, singular blow to plural attacks, and weakens the self-objectifying assessment.

findings.highlight: Her irritated voice is rather surprisingly beautiful.
findings.evidenceJa: 苛立ちを含んだ声は、同時に、ぞっとするほど綺麗だった。
findings.governingReading: Rider’s irritated voice is simultaneously beautiful enough to send a chill through Shirou.
findings.explanation: “Surprisingly beautiful” removes the frightening, bodily chill and the coexistence of irritation, terror, and beauty.

findings.highlight: You’re not as good as the other Servants!
findings.evidenceJa: 他のサーヴァントに比べたら迫力不足だ！
findings.governingReading: Shirou taunts that Rider lacks imposing force or presence compared with the other Servants.
findings.explanation: “Not as good” converts a bluff about intimidation into a broad judgment of inferior ability.

findings.highlight: I swing at the Servant in front of me.
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち塞がるサーヴァントを薙ぎ払う。
findings.governingReading: Shirou sweeps aside the Servant blocking his path.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only an attempted swing and omits the clearing direction and apparent result.

findings.highlight: jumps back.
findings.evidenceJa: 長い髪をなびかせて跳び退いた。
findings.governingReading: Rider leaps backward with her long hair streaming.
findings.explanation: The English keeps retreat but removes the long, flowing hair that sustains her elegance amid combat.

findings.highlight: You were already captured.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方は、始めから私に捕われているのですから
findings.governingReading: Rider reveals that Shirou has been caught by her from the very beginning.
findings.explanation: The English omits both Rider as captor and the trap’s duration from the start, weakening her deliberate spatial control.

findings.highlight: The pierced arm
findings.evidenceJa: ただでさえ大穴が開いている腕
findings.governingReading: The arm already has a gaping hole through it before the chain begins pulling.
findings.explanation: “Pierced arm” removes the wound’s size and open-hole bodily horror.

findings.highlight: is being pulled by some force!?
findings.evidenceJa: 何か得体の知れない力に引っ張られている！？
findings.governingReading: The damaged arm is being pulled by some uncanny, wholly unidentifiable force.
findings.explanation: “Some force” omits 得体の知れない and the terror of not understanding what has seized him.

findings.highlight: That thing in your arm is my nail.
findings.evidenceJa: 私の杭だという事に
findings.governingReading: Rider identifies the embedded object as her stake.
findings.explanation: “Nail” collapses 杭 into the earlier visual comparison and obscures the chain weapon’s actual impaling function.

findings.highlight: The arm moves up by itself and is lifted up.
findings.evidenceJa: 血に濡れた腕はひとりでに持ち上がり、そのままどこまでも持ち上げられていく。
findings.governingReading: The blood-soaked arm rises by itself and continues being hauled ever higher without limit.
findings.explanation: The English omits the blood and unbounded continuation, flattening the escalating suspension into repetitive generic motion.

findings.highlight: My arm’s about to be torn off. Ignoring my agony, it lifts me up.
findings.evidenceJa: 苦痛を無視し、伸びきる。
findings.governingReading: Ignoring the agony, Shirou’s arm is pulled fully taut before the chain suspends his body.
findings.explanation: The English adds an unsupported near-amputation sentence and assigns the lifting action to the arm/body instead of describing the arm stretched to its limit.

findings.highlight: You said I am inferior to other Servants?
findings.evidenceJa: 「この私が他のサーヴァントに劣る、と。
findings.governingReading: Japanese page62 corresponds to the second English page61 occurrence; subsequent English labels remain one behind through the ending.
findings.explanation: The duplicated English page61 label breaks label-level alignment: JP62→EN61#2, JP63→EN62, and JP64→EN63, leaving English page64 as the empty tail label.

findings.highlight: I’m like a sacrifice.
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=もず o2o=1]百舌の[ruby text=はやにえ char=2]早贄。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is like a shrike’s impaled stored prey, with the reading explicitly supplied.
findings.explanation: “A sacrifice” removes the shrike, impalement, stored-prey image, and written/reading layer that precisely mirrors his suspension.

findings.highlight: licks the tip of it.
findings.evidenceJa: ぬらり、とその先端に舌を這わせ
findings.governingReading: Rider slowly and slickly runs her tongue along the dagger’s tip.
findings.explanation: The English preserves licking but omits the viscous, predatory manner that defines Rider’s menace and sensuality.

findings.highlight: We stare at each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 思わず遠坂と顔を見合わせた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou and Rin involuntarily exchange a look at the scream.
findings.explanation: “Stare” suggests sustained looking and omits the reflexive mutual exchange of startled recognition.

findings.highlight: “…A scream.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「悲鳴、だったわよね」
findings.governingReading: Rin confirms with Shirou that what they heard was a scream.
findings.explanation: The English fragment identifies a scream but removes her confirmation-seeking relation with Shirou.

findings.highlight: That’s why I’m telling you it’s dangerous!
findings.evidenceJa: だから危ないって言ってるんじゃない、ばか！
findings.governingReading: Rin angrily calls Shirou an idiot while insisting that his awareness of danger is precisely why he must not rush ahead.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the reasoning but drops the pointed insult and its urgent familiar voice.

findings.highlight: there’s one collapsed female student lying there.
findings.evidenceJa: 女生徒らしき人影が倒れ伏している
findings.governingReading: A collapsed human figure that appears to be a female student is the only presence in the hall.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the tentative identification of a silhouette into a definite female student before they reach her.

findings.highlight: Her face looks serious. She tends to the female student while sweat forms on her forehead.
findings.evidenceJa: その横顔は真剣そのものだ。額に汗を浮かばせながら、女生徒の安否を気遣う。
findings.governingReading: Rin’s profile is utterly serious as she sweats and anxiously watches over whether the girl will survive safely.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the profile and turns explicit concern for the girl’s fate into the physical act of tending her.

findings.highlight: Geez, it’s so annoying…!
findings.evidenceJa: ああもう、気が散るっ……！
findings.governingReading: Rin complains that the wind and Shirou’s presence are breaking her concentration during treatment.
findings.explanation: “Annoying” changes impaired concentration into generic irritation, making her request sound merely temperamental.

findings.highlight: We ran here right after we heard the scream, so the emergency exit is the only place to get away from.
findings.evidenceJa: 悲鳴が聞こえて一分と経たずに駆けつけたんだから、犯人が逃げるとしたらその非常口ぐらいしかない。
findings.governingReading: Because they arrived less than a minute after the scream, the emergency exit is effectively the culprit’s only possible escape route.
findings.explanation: The English omits the under-one-minute constraint and the culprit-specific conditional, weakening Shirou’s deduction.

findings.highlight: Something like a dagger has pierced through my arm.
findings.evidenceJa: もはや短剣と呼べるそれは、ものの見事に俺の腕を貫通していた。
findings.governingReading: The iron object can now properly be called a dagger, and it has cleanly and spectacularly punched through Shirou’s arm.
findings.explanation: “Something like” restores uncertainty after the source resolves the category and omits the emphatic completeness of the penetration.

findings.highlight: “[line4]Please take care of her, Tohsaka.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「[line4]遠坂、その子任せた」
findings.governingReading: Without waiting for agreement, Shirou tersely entrusts the girl to Rin.
findings.explanation: “Please take care” turns his urgent declaration of trust and assigned responsibility into a polite request.

findings.highlight: The arm’s red below my elbow.
findings.evidenceJa: 肘から下は血で真っ赤になっている。
findings.governingReading: Below the elbow, Shirou’s arm is bright red with blood.
findings.explanation: The English omits the blood causing the redness, weakening the visible severity of the wound.

findings.highlight: my skin’s cut.
findings.evidenceJa: 皮膚がずるりと裂けている。
findings.governingReading: The skin of Shirou’s throat has split open with a slick peeling sensation.
findings.explanation: “Cut” removes both the splitting action and ずるり’s disturbing texture.

findings.highlight: I desperately swing my weapon above me.
findings.evidenceJa: 左手の武器で、自らの頭上を振り払った。
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses the weapon in his left hand to sweep the space directly above his own head.
findings.explanation: The English omits the left hand, relevant because his right arm is transfixed and dangling.

findings.highlight: jumping through the woods as if she’s sticking to the trees.
findings.evidenceJa: 木々に張り付くように雑木林をすり抜けていく。
findings.governingReading: Rider slips through the grove as though clinging to the trees like a spider.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes jumping for the source’s smooth slipping traversal, changing her uncanny movement.

findings.highlight: I have a weapon in my hand, even if it may be a weak one.
findings.evidenceJa: 拙いけれど、この腕には武器がある。
findings.governingReading: Crude though his means are, this arm still possesses a weapon.
findings.explanation: The English changes arm to hand and renders 拙い as weak, obscuring the contrast between Shirou’s poor skill/implement and his remaining capacity to act.

findings.highlight: She’s above me[line4]on a branch somewhere, as I expected.
findings.evidenceJa: 上[line4]やはり木の上に潜んでいるのか。
findings.governingReading: Hearing the voice above, Shirou wonders whether Rider is indeed concealed in the treetops.
findings.explanation: The English turns his location hypothesis into a confident statement and adds an unspecified branch.

findings.highlight: The nail comes for me.
findings.evidenceJa: 釘が振り下ろされる。
findings.governingReading: Rider swings the stake down at the suspended Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English removes the downward striking action and again calls the stake a nail.
